title: 3.1 Greetings and Names
unit_title: Unit 3: Me, You and Other People
unit_outcome: Greet people, say who you are, your age, where you are from and your job, and say what belongs to whom.
goal: Greet people with Hallo, Guten Morgen and Tschüss, ask Wie heißt du? and answer Ich heiße ...
grammar_function: Fixed phrases: Wie heißt du? Ich heiße + name.
speaking_outcome: Greet someone and say your name.
